decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the firm's core construction range and is still featured on its own page, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The articulated dumper is a core construction product with continued dedicated web presence and fits the firm's established offer.
The mine rescue vehicle was demoted from its own page to a mere mention, which signals weaker priority, but niche specialty vehicles are typically kept available on order by such manufacturers.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line builds on established competence in a growing market and remains prominently presented.
The material lift line is described as the most popular in rental and just won a large order, so it is clearly successful.
The compact mining loader shows strong field results of 1,000 operating hours in seven months and has its own page, supporting continued sales.
